description_en: For sale, 2-storey villa, Farka, Tirana. The villa is located in the Golden Oak Complex. Information about the villa: • 2-storey structure. • Construction area: 351 m2. • Land area: 864 m2. • Pool area: 47.4 m2. Organization: • Living room. • Cooking environment. • 4 Bedrooms. • 4 Toilets. • Porch. • Courtyard. • Swimming pool. • Private well. • Utility room. • Canteen. Other settings: • Contemporary architecture. • Large window surface. • The villa has 2 parking spaces. • Dense greenery. • Very close to TEG. • The complex consists of 22 villas. • Works are expected to be completed in December 2025. For a visit to the property contact us!
